about_the_game:
"The Endless Elegy at the Flowercape" is a dark fantasy style pixel Arpg. Players will use three heroines to travel in a world ravaged by natural disasters and tyrannies, encountering various companions, overcoming endless sadness and despair, until they reach the end of the world called "Flower Cape".

·Game Features

·Players can operate three heroines with different combat experiences, choose "talents", equip "imprints", and combine "skills" to explore the most suitable combat style for themselves.

 

·Exquisite dark fantasy art style

Ancient and desolate primitive villages, snow covered dragon nests in snowy countries, and plague harbors shrouded in thick fog... You can freely explore this dilapidated and dangerous world, fight against the filthy 'descendants', defeat countless terrifying' Scarred-Scions', and even challenge the crazy 'monarchs'.

·Rich storyline divergences

Experience this dark tale filled with sorrow and despair from the perspectives of three different heroines.

The main storyline features dozens of core NPCs, over 10 major endings, and more than 20 different branching paths.

Save those you wish to save, sparing no effort; destroy those you wish to destroy, even if it means making an enemy of the world.

 

·'Blooming'

At a critical moment, the girls will experience a 'bloom', transforming into the true form of their souls, even if the cost is the withering and extinguishing of their lives.

 

·Unique 'branding' inheritance mechanism

In the same playthrough game, if the "imprint" held by the heroine controlled by the player is completely shattered due to defeat, they will face irreversible death in that playthrough. Players can choose the successor of the "branding" among the remaining two heroiness until all three heroines die.

content_descriptors.notes: Some battles and performances contain bloody and violent content.
